notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional modified creature with power 1 or greater.
description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another modified creature with power one or greater.
When the creature dies, Mazirek and One with the Kami triggers.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Resolve the Mazirek trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat.
